Lisa (Acct: Brightline): Hey team — since yesterday our embeddings vectors/sec is ~60% lower even though tokens/sec is steady. Customers hitting timeouts. No obvious 4xx from our side, just slow vector responses. Anyone seen this pattern?
Sam (Support): sorry to hear — can you paste the API /request payload you used and an example response? quick check: is it dimension mismatch errors like "invalid dimension" or just slow? :eyes:
Lisa (Acct: Brightline): No error body. Example request: `POST /v1/embeddings` body: `{
  "model": "redwood-embed-v2",
  "inputs": [...],
  "batch_size": 64
}` Response 200 after ~7s (was ~1s). tokens/s metric unchanged.
Mia (SRE): tagging infra — can you share customer id? also what region? GPU queues can back up and throttle vectors while token route uses CPU path.
Lisa (Acct: Brightline): customer_id: brightline-prod-42, region: us-west-2. Happening across multiple pods/nodes.
Kevin (Infra): looking at cluster telemetry now — I see a burst of queue_depth on embed-service in us-west-2 from 03:10 UTC. GPU util for the serving pool is ~95% on several hosts and several small batches queued. Could be autoscaler not triggering new nodes.
Jorge (ML Eng): two quick hypotheses: 1) model routing might have fallen back to a different variant with lower throughput (quantized) that changes per-vector latency, 2) KV-cache thrashing if many short sequences and different prefixes. Any recent rollouts?
Sam (Support): Lisa, any chance you changed batching client-side or started sending many small requests? Also did you pin model_version?
Lisa (Acct: Brightline): We didn't change client. We do pin `model_version: latest` (i.e. float).
Mia (SRE): that might be it — `latest` can flip to a different optimized artifact during capacity events. Kevin, can you confirm model variant served for those requests?
Kevin (Infra): checked routing logs: between 03:08–03:12 a proportion of requests routed to `redwood-embed-v2-quant-small` due to fallback policy when dedicated capacity was constrained. That variant has different perf profile (higher latency per vector).
Jorge (ML Eng): that aligns. Also see a small but meaningful dim validation warning in logs: `expected dim 1536 got 1024` for a handful of requests — likely indicates embedding variant mismatch in downstream consumer. Could explain some retries and extra load.
Sam (Support): Lisa, two action items for repro: 1) pin `model_version` to `redwood-embed-v2@2026-02-15` to force the high-throughput variant; 2) try batching at client to `batch_size: 32` and measure vectors/sec. Can you run these steps and report?
Lisa (Acct: Brightline): doing now. Also note we briefly started seeing 401s in logs for a few requests around 03:09 but not persistent — maybe auth token rotation?
billing-bot: Billing alert — customer brightline-prod-42 exceeded quota fallback threshold at 03:11 UTC, temporarily throttled.
Mia (SRE): that billing throttle could explain fallback to secondary capacity tiers routed to quantized model. Kevin, correlate throttle events with routing changes.
Kevin (Infra): confirmed: billing throttle at 03:11 caused smart-router to route 18% of traffic to lower-cost pool with quantized model. That pool had higher GPU queueing because it's overcommitted.
Jorge (ML Eng): root cause looks like quota->fallback->quant-variant->gpu-queue. Fix: unthrottle or increase quota, or change fallback policy to prefer latency-preserving variants. Also add a safeguard: do not route embeddings heavy workloads to quant-variant if request header `x-priority: high`.
Sam (Support): immediate mitigations: 1) Lisa, increase quota or disable auto-fallback on your account while we stabilize; 2) set `model_version` pin to avoid roll to quant; 3) temporary client-side rate-limiting.
Lisa (Acct: Brightline): pinned and lowered client concurrency to 8. After 5m vectors/sec recovered to ~85% of baseline, timeouts dropped. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Mia (SRE): we'll follow up with infra and billing to adjust fallback heuristics. I'll open an incident ticket to track permanent fixes.
incidents-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-347: embeddings throughput regression (linked to route fallback + billing throttle).
Jorge (ML Eng): for long-term: recommend metric alerts on tokens/sec vs vectors/sec divergence, and a dashboard widget showing model_variant ratio per region.
Sam (Support): adding runbook steps for support: how to check `route_variant` in logs, and how to advise customers to pin models. I'll attach repro commands.
Sam (Support): repro curl for telemetry: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/stats?customer=brightline-prod-42
```
Sam (Support): logs to check: `embed.router.variant`, `embed.queue.depth`, `embed.gpu.util`, `billing.fallback.count`.
Lisa (Acct: Brightline): thanks all — I'll keep monitoring. Please message when incident updates.
Mia (SRE): noted. Will post follow-ups and remediation plan in INC-2026-347. :eyes:
